The **Royal Spa Centre** source says the Centre was officially opened on **15 June 1972** by **Anthony Eden**, described as a former MP for Leamington and Warwick and Prime Minister of the UK.

The **Anthony Eden** source identifies him as a **British Conservative politician**.

Therefore, the political party was the **Conservative Party**. This is also supported by the **Conservative Party (UK)** source title.

Final answer: Conservative Party (UK)
